note: The script asks for the hook question, one name super, three key words and a number pop, so 4 graphics and the end card. The campaign pages, the stock shot and the run clips are footage, not graphics.

mg.title: Hook question

text.main: What do you wish more people knew they could do on Watsi?

mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1, the FAQ question: What do you wish more people knew they could do on Watsi?
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:05. Top third.

mg.title: Name super
mg.use: Put it on at the start of the row for 2.5 s, above the captions. Type the second line Director of Marketing & Insights under it. No box: drop the container or sit it on a Watsi brand shape.

mg.title: Key words
mg.cue: Key words one at a time as she says them, top band: Your birthday / A marathon / Your wedding.
mg.use: Each word lands on hers, after the campaigns page recording. Captions stay on.

mg.title: Number pop
mg.cue: Number pop on her words 100% of it
mg.use: On her words “100% of it”, near the end of the row. 1.6 s, then gone.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: watsi.org, all lowercase, Lato, navy #2E2844. One line. Nothing else.
